name: local/otel-php-sidecar
description: OpenTelemetry SDK + auto-instrumentation for app-main, loaded via auto_prepend_file. NOT the app's dependencies: ensure.sh copies this file to build/composer.json and adds a replace/provide block generated from the app's composer.lock, so every package the app already ships is taken from the app's vendor (exact version) and only OTel-only packages land in build/vendor.
